issues.description: AC5's second grep command (`grep -rn '?start=ci_' apps/bot/src --include=*.ts | grep -v '.test.ts'`) returns 2 lines rather than the spec's literally-stated 'exactly one line' -- both lines are inside apps/bot/src/domain/qr.ts (one is the actual deep-link template-literal construction, the other is a header comment describing the same format). This is not a functional gap (no duplication outside domain/qr.ts, which is what AC5 exists to prevent), but the spec's pass-condition wording doesn't account for a comment echoing the literal inside the same file. Recommend TEST-DESIGNER tighten the wording (e.g. 'at most the lines inside domain/qr.ts, zero elsewhere') on a future spec revision.
